apply_transform_weight_input: apply a rotation matrix to an input tensor for a linear layer weight transformation
apply_transform_weight_weight: apply a transposed rotation matrix to a weight tensor for a linear layer rotation
multihead_matmul_block_diagonal: perform block-diagonal matrix multiplication when the left tensor inner dimension is larger than the right
multihead_matmul_standard: perform standard matrix multiplication when both tensors have matching inner dimensions
multihead_matmul_repeat_blocks: perform block-diagonal matrix multiplication when the right tensor inner dimension is larger than the left
